title: Processing Wastewater Samples for Bacterial & Viral Targets Enrichment
author: Victor Mabasa
materials: Using correct personal protective equipment (PPE), collect a 1 000 mL grab wastewater sample from each location in a sterile bottle and transfer them to the laboratory in a cold chain (keep in a lab fridge at 4°C). it is important to proceed to the next step within the next 23 hours after sample collection to prevent major degradation of microorganisms.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the laboratory environment and materials for processing wastewater samples.

substeps.instruction: Perform all work in a Class II biological safety cabinet wearing appropriate PPE.
Clean the workspace with a 1% Virkon solution and a 70% ethanol solution.
Double-line the waste bucket with biohazard waste plastic.
Label 250 mL conical centrifuge bottles, one for each wastewater sample.

steps.title: Transfer Wastewater Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 mL of the wastewater samples into the corresponding labeled conical tubes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 4,650 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C, with the deceleration speed set at 5.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant from the 250 mL conical bottle to a clean, marked 1,000 mL bottle without disturbing the settled solids.

steps.title: Process Remaining Sample
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifugation and supernatant transfer steps until the original sample is finished.

steps.title: Store Clarified Wastewater
steps.instruction: Keep the clarified wastewater sample at 4°C for downstream applications.

steps.title: Collect and Process Settled Solids
steps.instruction: Extract and prepare the settled solids for storage.

substeps.instruction: Use clean, plain wooden sticks to pick out settled solids and pack them into marked 2 mL cryo-tubes.

steps.title: Store Settled Solids
steps.instruction: Store the settled solids in the –80°C freezer until needed for downstream applications.
